Maya Park: FYI — Sapphire (partner) wants to provision capacity in eu-central-2 next week. They requested 8x A10G-equivalent GPUs, KMS integration, and marketplace entitlement. Can we fast-track approvals? :pray:
Luis Ortega: Thanks Maya. Do we have the exact SKU they need or is it a generic GPU quota?
Maya Park: They sent this list: 
- sku: sapphire-eu2-a10g
- initial commit: 8 GPUs (1 month trial)
- expected steady-state: 32 GPUs within 90 days
Maya Park: Also need marketplace listing enablement so they can buy through partner portal.
Chen Wei: For quota we need partner account ID + billing account. Can Maya drop the partner account and the desired start date?
Maya Park: Partner account is 590-442-77, start date target: 2026-10-05. Shared via DM because billing ids are PII.
Luis Ortega: KMS — which provider? They want Customer-Managed keys (AWS KMS) or Cloud KMS?
Maya Park: They prefer Cloud KMS in eu-central-2. They can use our BYOK flow.
Olivia Grant: Heads up from legal: we need the marketplace contract addendum signed before enabling entitlement. I can approve the addendum but need signature from Sapphire legal and a PO or committed spend number.
Maya Park: Sapphire agreed to a 90-day PO for the trial: EUR 40k. I'll get signed doc and upload it to the contract tracker.
RileyBot: Deploy-bot: Created ticket PART-2157 for marketplace entitlement + KMS onboarding. Assigned to @Luis Ortega and @Chen Wei. ETA 48h for initial review.
Luis Ortega: I'll start quota petition with infra immediately. Can you confirm the exact VM image family? Need to ensure kernel compat with our runtime.
Maya Park: They plan to use our runtime image: redwood-runtime:2026.09-gpu. I've asked them to run a small smoke test and post logs.
Chen Wei: Once infra confirms quota, I can do a quick perf pass and validate latency targets. If they hit <120ms p50 for small requests we're good.
Olivia Grant: I'll queue the addendum for signature. If they sign within 24h we can flip the marketplace switch after infra green.
Maya Park: Great. Action items: 1) Luis: quota petition + infra SKU validation (ETA 24h) 2) Chen: perf validation plan (ETA 48h) 3) Olivia: addendum signature chase 4) Maya: collect PO and smoke-test logs.
Luis Ortega: Noted. Starting petition now. Posting progress in this thread.
Chen Wei: I'll prepare a minimal perf harness (script + prompt set) and share in #eng-ml for a quick run.
Maya Park: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update Sapphire and ping once PO & signed addendum are uploaded.
RileyBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 48h.
